body.id: Persen berantai dikalikan, bukan dijumlah. Diskon 20% lalu 10%: 0,8 × 0,9 = 0,72, jadi Anda membayar 72% dan hemat 28%.
body.en: Chained percents multiply; they don't add. 20% off then 10% off: 0.8 × 0.9 = 0.72, so you pay 72% and save 28%.

body.id: Markup dihitung dari modal, margin dari harga jual. Modal Rp80.000, jual Rp100.000: markup 25%, margin 20%.
body.en: Markup is measured on the cost, margin on the selling price. Cost Rp80,000, price Rp100,000: 25% markup, 20% margin.

body.id: Mencari harga sebelum diskon atau pajak? Bagi, jangan dikurangi: Rp111.000 : 1,11 = Rp100.000.
body.en: Looking for the price before a discount or tax? Divide, don't subtract: Rp111,000 ÷ 1.11 = Rp100,000.

body.id: Rasio 1 : 3 berarti 1 bagian banding 3 bagian, total 4 bagian. Bagian pertama adalah 1/4 dari semuanya.
body.en: A 1 : 3 ratio means 1 part to 3 parts, 4 parts in all. The first part is 1/4 of the whole.

body.id: Menskalakan resep: kalikan semua bahan dengan faktor yang sama. Dari 4 porsi ke 10 porsi berarti × 2,5.
body.en: To scale a recipe, multiply every ingredient by the same factor. Going from 4 to 10 servings means × 2.5.

body.id: Bandingkan harga per satuan, yaitu harga dibagi isi. Kemasan besar tidak selalu lebih murah.
body.en: Compare the price per unit: the price divided by the amount. The big pack isn't always cheaper.

meaning.id: Sepatu Rp400.000 didiskon 30%, lalu didiskon lagi 10%. Berapa yang Anda bayar?
meaning.en: Shoes cost Rp400,000, with 30% off and then another 10% off. How much do you pay?

meaning.id: Diskon 50% lalu diskon 50% lagi berarti barangnya gratis.
meaning.en: 50% off and then another 50% off means it's free.

model_answer.id: Salah. Anda masih membayar 0,5 × 0,5 = 0,25 dari harga, yaitu 25%.
model_answer.en: False. You still pay 0.5 × 0.5 = 0.25 of the price, which is 25%.

meaning.id: Harga awal semuanya Rp100.000. Urutkan harga akhirnya, termurah dulu.
meaning.en: Every item starts at Rp100,000. Order the final prices, cheapest first.

meaning.id: Tagihan makan Rp250.000. Restoran ini menambah servis 5%, lalu pajak 10% dari total itu. Kira-kira berapa yang dibayar?
meaning.en: A meal bill is Rp250,000. This restaurant adds 5% service, then 10% tax on that total. Roughly how much do you pay?

meaning.id: Pasangkan perubahan dengan pengalinya.
meaning.en: Match each change with its multiplier.

meaning.id: Modal segelas es kopi Rp6.000, dijual Rp8.000. Berapa persen marginnya (dari harga jual)?
meaning.en: An iced coffee costs Rp6,000 to make and sells for Rp8,000. What is the margin, as a percent of the selling price?

meaning.id: Es kopi yang sama: modal Rp6.000, harga jual Rp8.000. Berapa markupnya (dari modal)?
meaning.en: The same iced coffee: cost Rp6,000, price Rp8,000. What is the markup, as a percent of cost?

model_answer.id: Untung Rp2.000 dibagi modal Rp6.000 ≈ 33,3%. Margin hanya 25%, karena dihitung dari harga jual.
model_answer.en: Profit Rp2,000 divided by the cost Rp6,000 ≈ 33.3%. The margin is only 25%, because it's measured on the price.

meaning.id: Persen untung ini dihitung dari modal atau dari harga jual?
meaning.en: Is this profit percent measured on the cost or on the selling price?

meaning.id: Modal Rp40.000. Anda ingin margin 20% dari harga jual. Harga jual = Rp40.000 : __
meaning.en: Cost is Rp40,000. You want a 20% margin on the selling price. Price = Rp40,000 ÷ __

model_answer.id: Rp40.000 : 0,8 = Rp50.000. Cek: untung Rp10.000 : Rp50.000 = 20%. Markup 20% (Rp48.000) tidak cukup.
model_answer.en: Rp40,000 ÷ 0.8 = Rp50,000. Check: profit Rp10,000 ÷ Rp50,000 = 20%. A 20% markup (Rp48,000) is not enough.

meaning.id: Setelah diskon 20%, harga tas Rp96.000. Berapa harga awalnya?
meaning.en: After 20% off, a bag costs Rp96,000. What was the original price?

model_answer.id: Rp96.000 : 0,8 = Rp120.000. Menambah 20% dari Rp96.000 memberi Rp115.200, dan itu keliru.
model_answer.en: Rp96,000 ÷ 0.8 = Rp120,000. Adding 20% of Rp96,000 gives Rp115,200, which is wrong.

meaning.id: Harga laptop Rp5.550.000 sudah termasuk PPN 11%. Berapa harga sebelum PPN?
meaning.en: A laptop costs Rp5,550,000 including 11% VAT (PPN). What is the price before VAT?

model_answer.id: Rp5.550.000 : 1,11 = Rp5.000.000. Mengurangi 11% dari Rp5.550.000 memberi Rp4.939.500, itu terlalu kecil.
model_answer.en: Rp5,550,000 ÷ 1.11 = Rp5,000,000. Taking 11% off Rp5,550,000 gives Rp4,939,500, which is too low.

meaning.id: Harga naik 25% menjadi Rp150.000. Susun cara mencari harga lama.
meaning.en: A price rose 25% to Rp150,000. Build the way to find the old price.

model_answer.id: Rp150.000 : 1,25 = Rp120.000. Bukan Rp150.000 × 0,75 = Rp112.500: turun 25% dari harga baru tidak kembali ke harga lama.
model_answer.en: Rp150,000 ÷ 1.25 = Rp120,000. Not Rp150,000 × 0.75 = Rp112,500: 25% off the new price doesn't get you back.

meaning.id: Tas Rp300.000 didiskon 20%, lalu 15% lagi. Berapa yang Anda bayar?
meaning.en: A bag costs Rp300,000, with 20% off and then another 15%. How much do you pay?

meaning.id: Modal segelas teh Rp3.000, dijual Rp5.000. Berapa marginnya (dari harga jual)?
meaning.en: A glass of tea costs Rp3,000 to make and sells for Rp5,000. What is the margin, on the selling price?

model_answer.id: Untung Rp2.000 : Rp5.000 = 40%. Markupnya ≈ 66,7%, karena dihitung dari modal.
model_answer.en: Profit Rp2,000 ÷ Rp5,000 = 40%. The markup is ≈ 66.7%, because it's measured on the cost.

meaning.id: Setelah diskon 40%, harga sepatu Rp180.000. Berapa harga awalnya?
meaning.en: After 40% off, the shoes cost Rp180,000. What was the original price?

items.source: C. R. Charig et al., 'Comparison of treatment of renal calculi by open surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy, and extracorporeal shockwave lithotripsy', BMJ 292 (1986): 879-882; S. A. Julious and M. A. Mullee, 'Confounding and Simpson's paradox', BMJ 309 (1994): 1480-1481.

model_answer.id: Paradoks Simpson: dalam studi batu ginjal tahun 1986, operasi terbuka lebih sering berhasil untuk batu kecil (93% vs 87%) dan untuk batu besar (73% vs 69%), tetapi totalnya tampak kalah (78% vs 83%). Sebabnya, operasi terbuka lebih banyak dipakai untuk kasus yang berat.
model_answer.en: Simpson's paradox: in a 1986 kidney-stone study, open surgery succeeded more often for small stones (93% vs 87%) and for large stones (73% vs 69%), yet looked worse overall (78% vs 83%). The reason: open surgery was used more for the hard cases.

meaning.id: Es kopi susu: kopi : susu = 1 : 3. Untuk 400 ml minuman, berapa ml kopinya?
meaning.en: Iced milk coffee: coffee : milk = 1 : 3. For 400 ml of drink, how many ml of coffee?

model_answer.id: Total 4 bagian; 400 : 4 = 100 ml per bagian. Kopi 1 bagian = 100 ml.
model_answer.en: 4 parts in all; 400 ÷ 4 = 100 ml a part. Coffee is 1 part = 100 ml.

meaning.id: Sirup : air = 1 : 3. Berapa bagian sirup dalam minuman?
meaning.en: Syrup : water = 1 : 3. What share of the drink is syrup?

model_answer.id: 1 bagian dari 4 bagian = 1/4, bukan 1/3.
model_answer.en: 1 part out of 4 parts = 1/4, not 1/3.

meaning.id: Setara dengan 2 : 3 atau tidak?
meaning.en: Equivalent to 2 : 3 or not?

model_answer.id: Setara (dikali angka yang sama): 4 : 6, 6 : 9, 10 : 15. Tidak setara: 3 : 4, 5 : 6, 8 : 10.
model_answer.en: Equivalent (both parts times the same number): 4 : 6, 6 : 9, 10 : 15. Not equivalent: 3 : 4, 5 : 6, 8 : 10.

meaning.id: Menambah 1 ke kedua bagian rasio 2 : 3 (jadi 3 : 4) tidak mengubah rasionya.
meaning.en: Adding 1 to both parts of the ratio 2 : 3 (making 3 : 4) doesn't change the ratio.

model_answer.id: Salah. 2 : 3 ≈ 0,67, sedangkan 3 : 4 = 0,75. Menambah mengubah rasio; mengali tidak.
model_answer.en: False. 2 : 3 ≈ 0.67, but 3 : 4 = 0.75. Adding changes a ratio; multiplying doesn't.

meaning.id: Nasi liwet: 2 gelas beras perlu 3 gelas air. Untuk 6 gelas beras, berapa gelas air?
meaning.en: Nasi liwet: 2 cups of rice need 3 cups of water. For 6 cups of rice, how many cups of water?

model_answer.id: 6 : 2 = 3, jadi airnya 3 × 3 = 9 gelas.
model_answer.en: 6 ÷ 2 = 3, so the water is 3 × 3 = 9 cups.

meaning.id: Mobil menempuh 156 km dengan 12 liter bensin. Dengan 30 liter, kira-kira berapa km?
meaning.en: A car goes 156 km on 12 litres of petrol. On 30 litres, roughly how many km?

meaning.id: Opor ayam untuk 4 porsi memakai 800 g ayam. Untuk 10 porsi perlu __ g.
meaning.en: Opor ayam for 4 servings uses 800 g of chicken. For 10 servings you need __ g.

meaning.id: Minyak goreng di pasar. Urutkan dari yang termurah per liter.
meaning.en: Cooking oil at the market. Order from cheapest per litre.

model_answer.id: Per liter: 2 L Rp17.000, 5 L Rp17.500, 1 L Rp18.000, 0,5 L Rp19.000. Kemasan terbesar bukan yang termurah.
model_answer.en: Per litre: 2 L Rp17,000, 5 L Rp17,500, 1 L Rp18,000, 0.5 L Rp19,000. The biggest pack is not the cheapest.

meaning.id: Susu mana yang paling hemat per liter?
meaning.en: Which milk is the best value per litre?

meaning.id: Beras di pasar. Pasangkan dengan harga per kg.
meaning.en: Rice at the market. Match each with its price per kg.

meaning.id: Pulau mana yang penduduknya paling padat (orang per km²)?
meaning.en: Which island group is the most densely populated (people per km²)?

model_answer.id: Jawa: sekitar 151 juta orang di sekitar 129.000 km², lebih dari 1.000 orang per km² (Sensus Penduduk 2020).
model_answer.en: Java: about 151 million people on about 129,000 km², over 1,000 people per km² (2020 Population Census).

meaning.id: Ojek A: Rp12.000 untuk 4 km. Ojek B: Rp20.000 untuk 8 km. Berapa tarif per km yang lebih murah?
meaning.en: Ojek A: Rp12,000 for 4 km. Ojek B: Rp20,000 for 8 km. What is the cheaper rate per km?

model_answer.id: A: Rp12.000 : 4 = Rp3.000 per km. B: Rp20.000 : 8 = Rp2.500 per km. B lebih murah.
model_answer.en: A: Rp12,000 ÷ 4 = Rp3,000 per km. B: Rp20,000 ÷ 8 = Rp2,500 per km. B is cheaper.

meaning.id: Gula : tepung = 1 : 2. Berapa bagian gula dalam adonan?
meaning.en: Sugar : flour = 1 : 2. What share of the mix is sugar?

model_answer.id: 1 bagian dari 3 bagian = 1/3, bukan 1/2.
model_answer.en: 1 part out of 3 parts = 1/3, not 1/2.

meaning.id: Adonan untuk 12 roti memakai 600 g tepung. Untuk 30 roti, berapa gram tepung?
meaning.en: Dough for 12 buns uses 600 g of flour. For 30 buns, how many grams?

meaning.id: Jus A: 250 ml Rp5.000. Jus B: 1.000 ml Rp18.000. Mana yang lebih hemat?
meaning.en: Juice A: 250 ml for Rp5,000. Juice B: 1,000 ml for Rp18,000. Which is better value?

model_answer.id: A: Rp5.000 : 250 = Rp20 per ml. B: Rp18.000 : 1.000 = Rp18 per ml. B lebih hemat.
model_answer.en: A: Rp5,000 ÷ 250 = Rp20 per ml. B: Rp18,000 ÷ 1,000 = Rp18 per ml. B is better value.

meaning.id: Harga naik 25%. Agar kembali ke harga semula, harga itu harus turun berapa persen?
meaning.en: A price goes up 25%. To get back to the original price, by what percent must it fall?

model_answer.id: Misalnya Rp100 naik 25% menjadi Rp125. Untuk kembali ke Rp100 harus turun Rp25, dan 25 : 125 = 20%.
model_answer.en: Say Rp100 rises 25% to Rp125. To get back to Rp100 it must fall by Rp25, and 25 ÷ 125 = 20%.
